## Freed v26.9.501-dev

Launch the complete interactive Freed demo experience, an interactive sample Library demo, and seek checkpoint pages through the export index

### Features

- Launch the complete interactive Freed demo experience
- An interactive sample Library demo

### Fixes

- Complete large checkpoint publications with bounded progress
- Retain provider opportunities while writer admission is blocked
- Automatic provider sync on unlocked macOS sessions restored
- Coalesce Drive checkpoint publication and fence cancellation
- Keep snapshot exports responsive and classify writer refusals
- Treat PWA Library contention as a busy state
- Preserve Library Core activation history across releases
- Keep local snapshot exports off the main thread so they do not block the interface or provider WebViews
- Seek directly to each checkpoint page instead of rescanning previously exported records
- Coalesce overlapping Drive publications and retain the export slot until canceled native work settles
- Recognize unlocked macOS sessions and accept fractional provider wake deadlines
- Distinguish missing or unreadable writer admission from a retired writer

### Follow-ups

- Route instruction contracts and harden governance
- Improve Drive checkpoint exports and restore provider scheduling on unlocked macOS sessions
- Verify Drive publication, writer admission, and LinkedIn extraction on the signed build
- Scheduled Facebook and Instagram observation on the installed build

### Downloads

**macOS:** `.dmg` (Apple Silicon or Intel, signed + notarized)  
**Windows:** `.exe` (NSIS installer)  
**Linux:** `.AppImage`  

> macOS downloads are signed and notarized for normal Gatekeeper installation.
